content.title: Coachella 2026 is sold out, but here’s how you can still find last‑minute tickets
content.text: BUDAPEST, HUNGARY - AUGUST 12: Justin Bieber performs on day three of Sziget Festival 2022 on Óbudai-sziget Island on August 12, 2022 in Budapest, Hungary.Joseph Okpako/WireImageIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Madison Kemeny | MKemeny@syracuse.comCoachella is right around the corner, returning April 10–12 and April 17–19, and while passes have been sold out for a hot minute, the resale market still has some surprisingly solid options available.The 2026 festival, held annually at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, features headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G and Anyma, supported by a massive lineup that includes The Strokes, Iggy Pop, Nine Inch Nails, Boys Noize and Young Thug, among many others. The full 2026 lineup is listed below.If you’re still hoping to attend, we’ve rounded up the best verified resale deals currently available so you can secure tickets before prices climb even higher.Where to buy Coachella 2026 ticketsIf you weren’t able to secure tickets during the presale or general sale, your next best option is to check verified secondary marketplaces such as Vivid Seats, which consistently offers the lowest resale prices.Discount: First-time Vivid Seats customers can use code ADVANCE30 for $30 off a $200+ ticket order.Prices vary by pass tier and demand, but Vivid Seats’ Buyer Guarantee protects against counterfeit or invalid tickets, making it a safer option for fans purchasing after the presale and general sale.Limited tickets may also be available via TicketNetwork, SeatGeek and StubHub.Get $5 off SeatGeek orders of $300+ with code TAKE5 or save 15% on TicketNetwork orders with code TIXDEAL15.Below are the current starting prices from verified resale marketplaces (prices include fees and are accurate at time of publishing, but subject to change):DatePass TierPricesApril 10-12 (Weekend One)GAStarting at $892April 10-12 (Weekend One)VIPStarting at $1,704April 17-19 (Weekend Two)GAStarting at $708April 17-19 (Weekend Two)VIPStarting at $1,454When does ‘Vanderpump Villa’ Season 3 premiere?
